title: Crew gives one Boost a month to a Circle or Space, lifting it in discovery for a week
detail: PHASE 4 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). A crew_boosts table (one per Crew per calendar month), a give action, and a discovery ranking lift for 7 days. Shipped: migration 20270346004300_crew_boosts.sql (one row per Crew per calendar month by a unique key, RLS on, select-own policy, internal grant), lib/crew/boost.ts (giveBoost: real effective Crew, not your own Circle or Space; activeBoostIds: 7-day window), the giveCrewBoost action behind a Boost button on Circle and Space pages, and the lift in the default Circle index order and the Space directory standing order, never inside the standing score.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const mig=fs.readdirSync("supabase/migrations").map((f)=>r("supabase/migrations/"+f)).join("\n");if(!/create table[^;]*crew_boosts/i.test(mig))fail("no crew_boosts table");if(!fs.existsSync("lib/crew/boost.ts"))fail("no boost module");console.log("ok: the monthly Boost exists")'
